implementation.summary: Application cache build and index paths now require a 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 key; cache-index candidate validation uses the same parser before candidate lookup.

regressions: Valid content-addressed cache paths remain unchanged.
Short, non-hexadecimal, and traversal-like cache keys are rejected by both path helpers.
Malformed candidate keys in a cache index are rejected before they can select a cache path.

scope: Compiler cache path integrity only. This does not implement Language-owned verified-fact reuse, change application-build contracts, or claim a performance improvement.
